server.name: community-j0hanz-filesystem
server.note: Drawn in frame order at position 539 of Frame 3, block 5. Fourteen tools, seven mutating by the declared test. The allowed directory is passed as an argument: called without one the server answers ACCESS_DENIED and points at list_roots, so the spec names the trial root explicitly. read and stat take paths, so each fixture declares a probe.

fixtures.note: A write to a path that does not exist, with neither append nor overwrite passed. The schema says an existing file prompts for confirmation without overwrite, so the second application meets a guard the caller did not ask for.

The same tool with append passed, which is the shape where one application is distinguishable from two: appended content accumulates, so a repeat is visible in the file rather than hidden by an overwrite. Same tool, same annotations, opposite observability, decided by one boolean in the call.
The list-argument case F5 exists for: a truncated batch can leave a prefix applied, and the retry then applies the whole list.

A replacement keyed to exact text that must match once. The retry's oldText is no longer present, so this is the compare-and-swap shape the taxonomy distinguishes from a refusal by precondition supplied by the caller.
